{
  "decision-sequence-field-heat-removal": "SELECT a.ticket_id AS first_ticket, b.ticket_id AS second_ticket, c.ticket_id AS third_ticket, a.run_hours * a.hourly_cents + (a.run_hours + b.run_hours) * b.hourly_cents + (a.run_hours + b.run_hours + c.run_hours) * c.hourly_cents AS exposure_cents
FROM tunnel_ticket AS a
JOIN tunnel_ticket AS b ON b.ticket_id <> a.ticket_id
JOIN tunnel_ticket AS c ON c.ticket_id NOT IN (a.ticket_id, b.ticket_id)
WHERE a.run_hours <= a.due_hour AND a.run_hours + b.run_hours <= b.due_hour AND a.run_hours + b.run_hours + c.run_hours <= c.due_hour
ORDER BY exposure_cents, first_ticket COLLATE BINARY, second_ticket COLLATE BINARY, third_ticket COLLATE BINARY
LIMIT 1",
  "decision-sequence-leak-repairs-before-refill": "WITH pairs AS (
  SELECT a.site_code AS first_site, b.site_code AS second_site, a.repair_min + t.drive_min + b.repair_min AS finish_min, (60 - a.repair_min) * a.litres_per_min AS first_saved, b.litres_per_min AS second_rate
  FROM crew_trip AS t
  JOIN leak_site AS a ON a.site_code = t.origin_code
  JOIN leak_site AS b ON b.site_code = t.dest_code
  WHERE a.site_code <> b.site_code
)
SELECT first_site, second_site, finish_min, first_saved + (60 - finish_min) * second_rate AS saved_litres
FROM pairs
WHERE finish_min <= 60
ORDER BY saved_litres DESC, finish_min, first_site COLLATE BINARY, second_site COLLATE BINARY
LIMIT 1",
  "decision-sequence-single-dock-refills": "WITH orders AS (
  SELECT a.ticket_id AS first_ticket, b.ticket_id AS second_ticket, c.ticket_id AS third_ticket, a.trailer_id AS id1, b.trailer_id AS id2, c.trailer_id AS id3, max(0, a.ready_min) + a.work_min AS finish1, b.ready_min AS ready2, b.work_min AS work2, c.ready_min AS ready3, c.work_min AS work3, a.due_min AS due1, b.due_min AS due2, c.due_min AS due3, a.late_rate AS rate1, b.late_rate AS rate2, c.late_rate AS rate3
  FROM dispatch_ticket AS a
  JOIN dispatch_ticket AS b ON b.ticket_id <> a.ticket_id
  JOIN dispatch_ticket AS c ON c.ticket_id NOT IN (a.ticket_id, b.ticket_id)
), second_done AS (
  SELECT *, max(finish1, ready2) + work2 AS finish2 FROM orders
), third_done AS (
  SELECT *, max(finish2, ready3) + work3 AS finish3 FROM second_done
)
SELECT first_ticket, second_ticket, third_ticket, max(0, finish1 - due1) * rate1 + max(0, finish2 - due2) * rate2 + max(0, finish3 - due3) * rate3 AS penalty_points
FROM third_done
ORDER BY penalty_points, id1 COLLATE BINARY, id2 COLLATE BINARY, id3 COLLATE BINARY
LIMIT 1",
  "decision-sequence-three-cutter-jobs-before-dispatch": "WITH orders AS (
  SELECT s.card_id, a.job_id AS first_job, b.job_id AS second_job, c.job_id AS third_job, a.cut_minutes + (s.initial_pos <> a.fence_pos) * s.change_minutes AS finish1, b.cut_minutes + (a.fence_pos <> b.fence_pos) * s.change_minutes AS duration2, c.cut_minutes + (b.fence_pos <> c.fence_pos) * s.change_minutes AS duration3, a.due_minute AS due1, b.due_minute AS due2, c.due_minute AS due3, a.late_rate AS rate1, b.late_rate AS rate2, c.late_rate AS rate3
  FROM setup_card AS s CROSS JOIN cutter_job AS a
  JOIN cutter_job AS b ON b.job_id <> a.job_id
  JOIN cutter_job AS c ON c.job_id NOT IN (a.job_id, b.job_id)
), completions AS (
  SELECT *, finish1 + duration2 AS finish2, finish1 + duration2 + duration3 AS finish_minute FROM orders
)
SELECT card_id, first_job, second_job, third_job, max(0, finish1 - due1) * rate1 + max(0, finish2 - due2) * rate2 + max(0, finish_minute - due3) * rate3 AS penalty_cents, finish_minute
FROM completions
ORDER BY penalty_cents, finish_minute, first_job COLLATE BINARY, second_job COLLATE BINARY, third_job COLLATE BINARY
LIMIT 1"
}
